answer.text: Stripe was founded by the Irish brothers Patrick Collison and John Collison in 2010. About the Founders Patrick Collison: Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Stripe. He attended the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) before dropping out. John Collison: Co-founder and President of Stripe. He attended Harvard University before dropping out.
